NR.extract: Nauru, also known by its native name Naoero and officially as the Republic of Naoero, is an island country in Oceania, in the South Pacific Ocean. It lies within the Micronesia region; its nearest neighbour, about 300 kilometres (190 mi) to the east, is Banaba, part of Kiribati. Yaren is its de facto capital.
NR.name: Nauru
